scenarios.text: A lift is stuck below the workshop. There is one charged battery module, one frayed cable, and three urgent jobs competing for the same power.
A noisy scrap sorter jams every few minutes. Nobody agrees whether the fault is the belt, a bent guide, or bad sensor timing, and stopping it for long loses useful material.
Two hand-drawn maps disagree about which tunnel reaches a cache of parts. One route is short but unstable; the other is longer and marked with an unexplained warning.
The shared bench is buried in mixed fasteners, broken connectors, useful offcuts, and rubbish. Nothing is immediately dangerous, but nobody wants to spend the whole shift sorting it.
